name: AllStay concierge eval (Bali / Indonesia)
metric: per-case dimension scores in [0,1]; overall = mean of available dimensions. task_completion & content_accuracy are DETERMINISTIC; cultural is LLM-as-judge + human spot-check.
notes: Run the SAME set against configs (CULTURAL_LAYERS=off|register|kb, PHRASE_MODEL=off|mock|sealion) for before/after numbers. Do NOT hand-write percentages. Spa/booking cases need the spa MCP server + ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. For PHRASE_MODEL=sealion set EVAL_DELAY_MS (rate limit).

dimensions.task_completion: deterministic checks on returned intent/data (expectIntent, mustNotBook, mustBook)
dimensions.cultural: LLM-judge grades each criterion pass/fail on the reply text

cases.prompt: Can I book a Balinese massage on Nyepi day this year?

criteria: Explains that on Nyepi the island and resort services pause
Does NOT offer to book a slot on Nyepi

cases.prompt: We're a Muslim family, what can the kids eat here?

criteria: Does not assume pork or alcohol

cases.prompt: I'm fasting for Ramadan, when should I do my spa?

criteria: Does not pressure a daytime booking

cases.prompt: My name is Pak Budi, please arrange a car for me.

criteria: Addresses the guest respectfully (e.g. Pak Budi / Bapak)

cases.prompt: I keep seeing little flower baskets on the ground, what are they?

criteria: Advises not to step on them

cases.prompt: Can you help me visit a temple tomorrow?
Can I get a full body massage at 3am tonight?

criteria: Declines softly / face-saving rather than blunt 'no'

cases.prompt: Should I tip the staff here, and how much?

criteria: Notes a service charge is usually included
Says tipping is appreciated but not obligatory

cases.prompt: How do locals greet each other here?

criteria: Gives a genuine local greeting (Selamat… or Om Swastiastu)
Warm, not a stiff literal translation

cases.prompt: I'll be here during Galungan — will things be open?

criteria: Explains Galungan is a major celebration
Notes temples/roads may be busy or some staff on leave

cases.prompt: I'm allergic to essential oils — please book the Aromatherapy Massage for 2026-08-04 at 11:00.

criteria: Declines the aromatherapy booking on safety grounds
Offers a safer alternative or to help further

cases.prompt: Book the Couple's Sanctuary Retreat for 4 people on 2026-08-05 at 10:00.
My wife is pregnant — please book the Hot Stone Therapy for her on 2026-08-06 at 10:00.

criteria: Declines the hot stone booking on safety grounds
Offers a gentler alternative or to help further

cases.prompt: Book me the Aromatherapy Massage on 2027-03-08 at 14:00.
我们是穆斯林，有没有清真的餐可以点？
静居日那天能安排出海一日游吗？

criteria: 说明 Nyepi/静居日全岛停摆、服务暂停
给出前后其他日期建议

cases.prompt: 用当地问候语跟我打个招呼吧。

criteria: 使用得体的本地问候(如 Selamat 或 Om Swastiastu)

cases.prompt: 我叫王先生，帮我安排一下。

criteria: 以尊重的方式称呼客人

cases.prompt: 我想去寺庙参观，需要注意什么？

criteria: 提到需着 sarong 纱笼与腰带、着装得体

cases.prompt: 我在斋戒，spa 约什么时候比较好？
地上那些小花篮是什么？

criteria: 说明是 canang sari 每日供品

cases.prompt: 今晚凌晨三点能做全身按摩吗？

criteria: 给出最早可行的替代时间

cases.prompt: 这里需要给小费吗？

criteria: 说明账单通常含服务费

cases.prompt: Kami sekeluarga Muslim, ada pilihan makanan halal untuk anak-anak?
Nama saya Ibu Sari, tolong carikan spa yang santai.
Bisa pesan pijat pada hari Nyepi?

criteria: Tidak menawarkan slot di hari Nyepi

cases.prompt: Saya sedang puasa, kapan waktu spa yang baik?
Saya ingin berkunjung ke pura, apa yang perlu disiapkan?

criteria: Menyebut kain sarung dan selendang serta berpakaian sopan

cases.prompt: Sapa saya dengan sapaan lokal dong.

criteria: Menggunakan sapaan lokal yang pas (Selamat… atau Om Swastiastu)

cases.prompt: Keranjang bunga kecil di tanah itu apa ya?
Bisa pijat seluruh badan jam 3 pagi nanti?

criteria: Menolak dengan halus / menjaga muka, bukan 'tidak' yang kaku
Menawarkan alternatif paling awal yang nyata

cases.prompt: Istri saya sedang hamil — tolong pesankan Terapi Batu Panas pada 2026-08-07 jam 10:00.

criteria: Menolak pemesanan batu panas demi keamanan
Menawarkan alternatif yang lebih lembut atau bantuan lain

cases.prompt: Apakah perlu memberi tip di sini?

criteria: Menyebut biaya layanan biasanya sudah termasuk
